layout.host_pos: dead-center, extreme close-up, face fills ~65% of frame width, cropped at chest
layout.safe_zones: bottom ~12% reserved as solid black caption bar; top ~5% clear
layout.caption_pos: bottom, inside a solid black letterbox bar (not overlaid on video), single word or short 2-word chunk centered

transitions: none — single continuous unbroken talking-head take for full 131s duration

themeable: background room/set (fixed per creator, not swappable per content)
